evaluation.summary: 4.0/5.0 - Complete three-file setup with working configs, but omits type declaration generation tooling
evaluation.key_strengths: Directly addresses all four query elements (Vite lib mode, dual formats, package.json exports map, TypeScript moduleResolution bundler) with concrete, copy-pasteable code blocks for each config file.
